task.question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
task.evidence: July 19 – The 2026 São Toméan presidential election was held, with incumbent nonpartisan President Carlos Vila Nova re-elected for a second five-year term.

answer: Carlos Vila Nova re-elected with 55.88% of the vote.

The 2026 São Toméan presidential election held on July 19 resulted in incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova being re-elected in the first round. He received approximately 55.88% of the vote, while his main opponent, Nito Abreu, garnered about 41.46%. The voter turnout was notably low at around 41%. 

FINAL: Carlos Vila Nova re-elected with 55.88% of the vote.
